title: umto_chorale — identification mode
description: Score-based click-to-identify exercise. Student sees notation with ? slots below each target onset, clicks to open a popup, and picks the correct label. Graded by IdentificationGrader. Paginated (4 problems/page by default). The correct answer is taken from score.umto.analysis[].content based on analysisType.

clef.description: Staff layout. Single-voice exercises use 'treble' or 'bass'. SATB use 'keyboard'.

analysisType.description: Determines what the ? slot asks and which AnalysisLayer field holds the answer. See analysisType→field mapping below.

identMode.description: practice=immediate feedback per slot, submit=reveal on Submit button, test=no color feedback.

compoundIntervals.description: For interval_* analysisTypes: if false, intervals >octave are simplified (10th→3rd). Enforced at import time.

inputMode.description: dropdown=popup list, text=typed input (accepts case-sensitive tokens like 'M3', 'm6', 'P5').

allowed_answers.description: Full set of answer strings shown in popup choices. Subset of these appears per slot as choices[].

grading.description: Grading slices present in payload even for click-based exercises. Used by IdentificationGrader to resolve absolute answer indices.

score.description: Contains CIR measures (for rendering) and score.umto (canonical UMTO with analysis slices that drive ? targets).

umto.description: score.umto.analysis[] entries with is_target:true generate ? slots. The correct answer is resolved from content based on analysisType.

content.description: AnalysisLayer. Which field is used as the answer depends on analysisType.

is_target.description: true = renders a ? button at this offset.

analysisType_to_answer_field.description: NOT a JSON Schema constraint — documents which AnalysisLayer field provides the correct answer for each analysisType. Implemented in exercise_definition.js computeWindowLabel().

note_name.const: pitch name derived from VoiceEvent.pitch at this offset (e.g. 'D', 'F#')

do_based_solfege.const: same as solfege but always relative to tonic

interval_specific.const: interval quality+size computed from top two voices via Tonal.js: 'M3','m6','P5'

interval_generic.const: interval size only: '3','6','8'. compoundIntervals controls simplification.

examples.introText: Identify the notes: BWV10.7, measures 6-7, Soprano voice.
